# Recursive function to walk the field tree
def walk_fields(field_obj, depth=0, parent_name=''):
    obj = field_obj if isinstance(field_obj, pikepdf.Dictionary) else pdf.get_object(field_obj)
    
    field_name = str(obj.get('/T', ''))
    field_type = str(obj.get('/FT', ''))
    field_value = str(obj.get('/V', ''))
    field_flags = obj.get('/Ff', '')
    opts = obj.get('/Opt', '')
    
    full_name = f'{parent_name}.{field_name}' if parent_name and field_name else (field_name or parent_name)
    
    kids = obj.get('/Kids', None)
    if kids:
        for kid in kids:
            walk_fields(kid, depth+1, full_name)
    else:
        # Leaf node - this is an actual widget
        ap = obj.get('/AP', '')
        ap_keys = ''
        if ap:
            normal = ap.get('/N', '')
            if normal and isinstance(normal, pikepdf.Dictionary):
                ap_keys = list(normal.keys())
        
        type_label = {'/Tx': 'Text', '/Btn': 'Button/Checkbox', '/Ch': 'Choice', '/Sig': 'Signature'}.get(field_type, field_type or 'Unknown')
        
        if field_name or full_name:
            print(f'  Name: {full_name:45s} Type: {type_label:20s} Value: {field_value:10s} AP_keys: {ap_keys}  Opts: {opts}  Flags: {field_flags}')

if acroform:

    for f in fields:
